name: Chris Vertin
original_name: クリス・ヴェルティン
source:
A seventeen-year-old who came to the town with his childhood friend Tortinita to attend the music school. He is a third-year student of the keyboard-like instrument Fortelle, and dreams to become an accomplished musician.

Apart from Tortinita and Asino, he virtually has no other friends at the school. A laid-back person, he is very talented at music.

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Symphonic_Rain]Wikipedia[/url]]
